🚀 RocketLaunch

A rocket sits on the launch pad — hold the launch button until the perfect moment and release. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Hold the launch button to build thrust.
  2. Release at the moment of peak thrust for maximum lift-off.
  3. The fuel burns as you hold — manage your burn time.
  4. Watch the thrust gauge and release at the optimal point.
  5. The rocket's altitude is determined by your launch timing.
